subject: Is "rstan on CRAN" at the end of the rainbow ?

messages.author: bcfb6bc9f75aae0f
messages.subject: Is "rstan on CRAN" at the end of the rainbow ?
parts:
Dear List,

Lurking on this list, I saw various messages hinting at the availability of rstan on CRAN. ISTR that someone recommended to Andrew Gelman to aim his time machine to the "next week"...

Well, I dunno for Andrew's but my time machine must have had severe hiccups : It's Easter and no rstan on CRAN. Do you still plan to deposit rstan on CRAN ?

On a related subject : there seems to be a 2.6.3 update to 2.6.0, but it is not pointed at by the "RStan Getting Started" page. Where can it be downloaded ?

Sincerely,

--
Emmanuel Charpentier

Juan Sebastian

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Is "rstan on CRAN" at the end of the rainbow ?
parts:
RStan should be coming to CRAN at some point in the hopefully not
too distant future. Like everyone else, we have to first
satisfy the gatekeepers. One piece of that puzzle is elimating
all vestiges of C++11, some of which are supported by all compilers
due to their being part of C, but are not officially part of C++03.

Here's the current numbering situation for the C++ version
of Stan:

2.6.1 was abandoned before a public release.

2.6.2 is the current official release behind the latest
RStan and PyStan.

2.6.3 has some very minor updates required to remove the last
vestiges of anti-CRAN behavior in Stan. It's such a trivial update
it's not even worth mentioning other than that we hope it removed
the last traces of C++11.

See here: https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/releases

The scheme is Major.Minor.Patch. Major versions introduce
major new features and/or break backward compatibility. Minor
versions introduce minor features and bug patches and maintain
backward compatibility. Patch releases just fix bugs without
adding new functionality.

RStan and PyStan and CmdStan follow Stan C++'s numbering.

RStan is still officially at 2.6.0.

PyStan has been updated to 2.6.3.

CmdStan has been updated to 2.6.2.

- Bob
